browser_generated_playwright_code.code:
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from vrt_sandbox import launch_chromium, write_result
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = launch_chromium(p)
    pg = b.new_page()
    pg.goto('https://example.com')
    write_result({'title': pg.title()})
    b.close()
